summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new sensor analytics drill-down feature. All functionality working perfectly including PFD sensor clicks, analytics data display, navigation, and auto-refresh. Previously tested features remain fully functional.
passed_tests: GET /api/sensors/{instrument_id}/analytics returns complete analytics data
Analytics endpoint validates instrument ID and returns 404 for invalid IDs
Time series data includes timestamps, values, rolling_avg_5, rolling_avg_10
Stats calculation (current, min, max, mean, std_dev, data_points) working correctly
Compliance thresholds properly configured for different sensor types
Recent alerts and anomalies filtered by instrument ID
PFD sensor dots clickable and open SensorAnalytics view
Sensor cards in Instrumentation panel clickable and open analytics
SensorAnalytics displays instrument name, ID, and type correctly
5 stat cards (Current, Mean, Min, Max, Std Dev) display with correct values
Time Series chart renders with Actual, Rolling Avg (5), and Rolling Avg (10) lines
Compliance threshold reference lines appear on charts
Trend Envelope area chart renders correctly
Recent Events section shows alerts and anomalies for selected instrument
Back to PFD button navigates back to main dashboard
Analytics data auto-refreshes every 10 seconds
PFD shows 'Click any sensor for analytics' hint text
Live indicator shows real-time updates
All previously tested features still work (dashboard, alerts, AI agent)
Multiple sensor types working (flow, pressure, pH, chlorine, conductivity, level)
